document.title: PMK 81/2024: Ketentuan perpajakan dalam rangka Coretax

delta.note: PMK 81/2024 regulates tax administration for the core tax administration system (Coretax). It covers registration, payment, deposit, reporting via SPT Masa PPh 21/26, installment and postponement of payment, and PPh 22/25 procedures. The provisions shown concern administration and reporting, such as the deadline for reporting PPh 21 withheld and the definition of the last tax period for SPT purposes. They do not change rates, PTKP, TER tables, deductions, or the calculation steps of PPh 21 for permanent employees.
